# ldap — LDAP and Active Directory

[All groups](README.md)

## ldap rootdse

Read a directory's root DSE: naming contexts, supported LDAP versions, SASL mechanisms, controls and extensions (with well-known OIDs named), vendor information and TLS details.

MCP tool: `ldap_rootdse`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--url` | string | Directory URL, e.g. ldaps://ldap.example.com:636 or ldap://host:389. **Required.** |
| `--starttls` | bool | Upgrade an ldap:// connection with StartTLS before binding. |
| `--bind-dn` | string | DN to bind as; omit for an anonymous bind. |
| `--ldap-password` | string | Bind password (prefer env IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## ldap bind

Test a bind against a directory: connect (LDAPS or StartTLS), bind, and ask the server who it thinks you are. Reports timings and TLS details.

MCP tool: `ldap_bind`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--url` | string | Directory URL, e.g. ldaps://ldap.example.com:636 or ldap://host:389. **Required.** |
| `--starttls` | bool | Upgrade an ldap:// connection with StartTLS before binding. |
| `--bind-dn` | string | DN to bind as; omit for an anonymous bind. |
| `--ldap-password` | string | Bind password (prefer env IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## ldap search

Search a directory and return the matching entries (binary values come back base64-encoded; Active Directory SIDs, GUIDs, account flags and timestamps are also decoded).

MCP tool: `ldap_search`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--url` | string | Directory URL, e.g. ldaps://ldap.example.com:636 or ldap://host:389. **Required.** |
| `--starttls` | bool | Upgrade an ldap:// connection with StartTLS before binding. |
| `--bind-dn` | string | DN to bind as; omit for an anonymous bind. |
| `--ldap-password` | string | Bind password (prefer env IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--base-dn` | string | Search base DN. **Required.** |
| `--filter` | string | LDAP filter. Default `(objectClass=*)`. |
| `--scope` | string | Search scope. Default `sub`. One of `base`, `one`, `sub`. |
| `--attributes` | list | Attributes to return (default all user attributes; add + for operational ones). |
| `--limit` | int | Maximum number of entries to return. Default `100`. |
| `--page-size` | int | Fetch results in pages of this size with the paged results control (RFC 2696), for directories that cap result sizes. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## ldap modify

Modify one directory entry: add, replace or delete attribute values. This changes data in the directory.

MCP tool: `ldap_modify`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--url` | string | Directory URL, e.g. ldaps://ldap.example.com:636 or ldap://host:389. **Required.** |
| `--starttls` | bool | Upgrade an ldap:// connection with StartTLS before binding. |
| `--bind-dn` | string | DN to bind as; omit for an anonymous bind. |
| `--ldap-password` | string | Bind password (prefer env IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--dn` | string | DN of the entry to modify. **Required.** |
| `--changes` | json | JSON array of changes, e.g. [{"op":"replace","attr":"description","values":["new"]}]; op is add, replace or delete. **Required.** |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## ldap add

Add an entry to the directory. This creates data.

MCP tool: `ldap_add`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--url` | string | Directory URL, e.g. ldaps://ldap.example.com:636 or ldap://host:389. **Required.** |
| `--starttls` | bool | Upgrade an ldap:// connection with StartTLS before binding. |
| `--bind-dn` | string | DN to bind as; omit for an anonymous bind. |
| `--ldap-password` | string | Bind password (prefer env IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--dn` | string | DN of the new entry. **Required.** |
| `--attributes` | json | Attributes as a JSON object of name to value or list of values, e.g. {"objectClass":["inetOrgPerson"],"cn":"Jane","sn":"Doe"}. **Required.** |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## ldap delete

Delete a leaf entry from the directory. This removes data and cannot be undone.

MCP tool: `ldap_delete`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--url` | string | Directory URL, e.g. ldaps://ldap.example.com:636 or ldap://host:389. **Required.** |
| `--starttls` | bool | Upgrade an ldap:// connection with StartTLS before binding. |
| `--bind-dn` | string | DN to bind as; omit for an anonymous bind. |
| `--ldap-password` | string | Bind password (prefer env IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--dn` | string | DN of the entry to delete (it must have no children). **Required.** |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## ldap rename

Rename an entry or move it under a new parent (ModifyDN). This changes data.

MCP tool: `ldap_rename`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--url` | string | Directory URL, e.g. ldaps://ldap.example.com:636 or ldap://host:389. **Required.** |
| `--starttls` | bool | Upgrade an ldap:// connection with StartTLS before binding. |
| `--bind-dn` | string | DN to bind as; omit for an anonymous bind. |
| `--ldap-password` | string | Bind password (prefer env IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--dn` | string | DN of the entry to rename. **Required.** |
| `--new-rdn` | string | New RDN, e.g. uid=jane.doe. **Required.** |
| `--delete-old-rdn` | bool | Remove the old RDN value from the entry. Default `true`. |
| `--new-superior` | string | DN of the new parent, to move the entry. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## ldap compare

Ask the directory whether an entry has an attribute value (Compare), without reading the attribute. Useful where search access is restricted.

MCP tool: `ldap_compare`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--url` | string | Directory URL, e.g. ldaps://ldap.example.com:636 or ldap://host:389. **Required.** |
| `--starttls` | bool | Upgrade an ldap:// connection with StartTLS before binding. |
| `--bind-dn` | string | DN to bind as; omit for an anonymous bind. |
| `--ldap-password` | string | Bind password (prefer env IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--dn` | string | DN of the entry. **Required.** |
| `--attribute` | string | Attribute to compare. **Required.** |
| `--value` | string | Value to compare against. **Required.** |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## ldap passwd

Change or reset a password. Uses the Password Modify extended operation (RFC 3062) where the server offers it, and Active Directory's unicodePwd attribute (over an encrypted connection only) where it does not. With old_password the user's own password is changed; without it an administrator resets it. RFC 3062 servers generate a password when new_password is omitted; Active Directory cannot. Without user_dn the bound user's password is changed.

MCP tool: `ldap_passwd`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--url` | string | Directory URL, e.g. ldaps://ldap.example.com:636 or ldap://host:389. **Required.** |
| `--starttls` | bool | Upgrade an ldap:// connection with StartTLS before binding. |
| `--bind-dn` | string | DN to bind as; omit for an anonymous bind. |
| `--ldap-password` | string | Bind password (prefer env IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_LDAP_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--user-dn` | string | Whose password to change; default is the bound user. |
| `--old-password` | string | Current password, if the server requires it (prefer env IDPDBG_OLD_PASSWORD). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_OLD_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--new-password` | string | New password; omit to have the server generate one (prefer env IDPDBG_NEW_PASSWORD). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_NEW_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--method` | string | extended (RFC 3062), unicodepwd (Active Directory), or auto: chosen from the root DSE. Default `auto`. One of `auto`, `extended`, `unicodepwd`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
